earnings.title: Analysts and Investors:
highlights: Delivered Revenue of $1.9 Billion, an Increase of 11% on a Reported Basis and 12% on a Pro Forma Basis Versus Prior Year, Led by 16% Growth at Coach Brand
Achieved GAAP Diluted EPS of $1.76, up 38% Versus Prior Year, and Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $1.82, an Increase of 32% Versus Prior Year
outlook: Increases Fiscal Year 2027 Capital Return Outlook to $2.0 Billion Driven by Incremental Share Repurchases

The Company now expects to return approximately $2.0 billion to shareholders in Fiscal 2027 through its capital return programs, an increase from prior guidance, which includes approximately $700 million returned in the fiscal first quarter:
In Fiscal 2027, the Company continues to anticipate an annual dividend of $1.85 per share.

Share Repurchases : Tapestry now expects to repurchase $1.7 billion in common stock in the fiscal year under its existing share repurchase authorization, an increase of $350 million versus its prior guidance.

items.heading: Economic conditions, such as an economic recession, downturn, periods of inflation or uncertainty, could materially adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and consumer purchases of discretionary items.
